t_advice_summary_textbox.text: To remain calm and to focus on the task at hand. Pay attention to what is going on the screen, and utilise the breaks when they are offered.

vb_textbox.text: I'd suggest sitting in a quiet room where you're not likely to be bothered. I would suggest alternating which gnome you choose each round to rest your fingers, there is no pattern in terms of colour as to whether that gnome will consistently provide a higher or lower amount of mushrooms. Use the 5 minute breaks where needed to get water, perk yourself up and give yourself a mental break. Good luck!
